description: A genuine sleep-hygiene tip — one practical habit from the rotating collection of 12 (consistent wake times, light, wind-down routines; no medical claims). Rotates daily. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 (the live 402 challenge is authoritative). Payment follows the x402 two-phase exchange: unpaid calls receive the payment requirements (payTo, amount, accepted networks), and calls carrying a valid payment receive the data in the tool result. The tool itself makes no payments, handles no private keys, and holds no funds. Resale of the data output is permitted at the reseller's own price.

index.description: Tip index 0-11; when omitted, today's rotating tip is used.

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 v1 payment payload (the signed ExactEvmPayload JSON). Absent on the first call, which receives the payment requirements; present on the follow-up call, after signing in the caller's own wallet / x402 client. The server only forwards it to the rail — it never signs, never holds funds, never touches private keys.

name: qm_data_sleep_tip
